definitions.t_chain: median verify at k=1 minus t_local
definitions.P*(0.5): floor(50 ms / mean verify) per k
definitions.knee: t_chain / (0.5 ms - t_local): k at which the curve t_local + t_chain/k gives P*(0.5)=100; not reached when t_local >= 0.5 ms
definitions.measured_knee_tested_k: smallest tested k whose measured P*(0.5) >= 100
definitions.pooled: samples of all replicates of a mode concatenated per k
